name: Ragefire Chasm
where: Inside Orgrimmar (Cleft of Shadow). Horde only.
overview: A short first dungeon full of troggs and Searing Blade cultists. A full run takes 20–30 minutes.
before: Pick up the Orgrimmar quests: Searching for the Lost Satchel, Hidden Enemies (chain from Thrall) and Slaying the Beast.
route: Clear the troggs at the start
Follow the lava path down to Oggleflint and Taragaman
Continue round to the Searing Blade area for Jergosh and Bazzalan
tips: Searing Blade cultists cast Curse of Agony: mages and druids can remove it. Watch for patrols on the lava paths.

bosses.summary: Big demon that does a fire nova around himself and uppercuts the tank.
bosses.tank: Face him away from the group; expect to be knocked back.
bosses.healer: Keep the tank topped up through the uppercuts.
bosses.dps: Melee: back off when the fire nova hits if you're low.

bosses.summary: Caster that puts Curse of Weakness and Immolate (a fire DoT) on people.
bosses.tank: Pull him away from nearby cultists.
bosses.healer: Remove the curse if you can; heal through the burn.

name: Wailing Caverns
where: The Barrens, in the oasis south-west of the Crossroads. Entrance is in the mouth of the big skull rock.
overview: A big, winding cave of raptors, snakes and Druids of the Fang. Easy to get lost: stay together and follow the route. Takes 1–1.5 hours.
before: Grab Leaders of the Fang, Serpentbloom and Deviate Hides (Crossroads / outside the cave). The Disciple of Naralex at the entrance starts the final escort.
route: Go down the ramp to Lady Anacondra
Lord Cobrahn and Lord Pythas in the upper areas
Skum and Lord Serpentis through the lower tunnels
Talk to the Disciple of Naralex and escort him, then kill Mutanus
tips: Druids of the Fang sleep and heal: interrupt them. Deviate Faerie Dragon is a rare spawn. Don't let the escort NPC die.

bosses.summary: Druid caster that puts people to sleep and casts Lightning Bolt.
bosses.healer: Expect the sleep on you or the tank; be ready to catch up.
bosses.dps: Interrupt Lightning Bolt and Healing Touch.

bosses.summary: Giant turtle that wanders the water. Very simple.
Druid that casts Sleep, Thunderclap and heals himself.
Druid that turns into a snake and poisons you.
bosses.dps: Kill his adds quickly if he summons them.

bosses.summary: Lizard boss in the water with a chain lightning.
bosses.tank: Stand him near the edge so ranged can spread out.
bosses.dps: Ranged: spread out for Chain Lightning.

bosses.summary: Druid that sleeps a player and casts Lightning Bolt.
bosses.healer: Heal the tank through his melee.

bosses.summary: Plant giant that knocks people around with Grasping Vines.
bosses.tank: Keep him away from the cliff edge.

bosses.summary: Final boss after the Naralex escort. Puts people to sleep and does a big Thundercrack.
bosses.tank: Grab him fast when he appears.
bosses.healer: Stay at range; heal through the sleep and stun.
bosses.dps: Burn him down; he only spawns once the escort is done.

bosses.summary: Rare spawn, not always there. Can put people to sleep.
bosses.healer: Be ready if someone gets slept.

name: The Deadmines
where: Westfall, in Moonbrook. Enter the big mine building, the instance portal is at the bottom.
overview: The Defias Brotherhood's hideout. Mines and goblin workshops leading to a pirate ship. One of the best early dungeons. Takes about an hour.
before: Alliance: pick up Red Silk Bandanas, Oh Brother… and The Defias Brotherhood chain in Westfall/Stormwind. The big doors open by themselves as you kill the bosses in front of them.
route: Rhahk'Zor at the first big door
Sneed's Shredder then Sneed in the lumber room
Through the cannon door to the cove: Mr. Smite on the ship deck
Captain Greenskin and finally Edwin VanCleef on the top deck
Cookie is in the ship's lower area
tips: The cannon in the cove blows the door open. Lots of patrols in the cove: pull carefully.

bosses.summary: Ogre at the first door. Hits hard but has no tricks.
bosses.healer: Big melee hits: keep the tank topped up.

bosses.summary: Rare spawn that may or may not be there. A simple fight.
Lumber shredder. When it dies, Sneed jumps out.
bosses.tank: Be ready to pick up Sneed right away.

bosses.summary: Goblin who jumps out of his shredder and disarms.
Goblin smelter in the foundry. Uses molten metal attacks.
bosses.tank: Clear the goblins in the room first so they don't join in.

bosses.summary: Pirate cook on the ship. Heals himself with food.
Goes through phases, stunning everyone and swapping weapons.
bosses.healer: Top people up during the stun breaks.

bosses.summary: Ogre pirate with a cleave and some adds.
bosses.tank: Face him away from the group.

bosses.summary: Defias leader on the top deck. Calls Defias Blackguards to help partway through.
bosses.tank: Pick up the Blackguards when they appear.
bosses.healer: Expect extra damage when the adds come in.
bosses.dps: Kill the Blackguards, then finish Edwin.

name: Shadowfang Keep
where: Silverpine Forest, the castle south of the Sepulcher.
overview: A haunted castle full of worgen and undead. Has the famous Arugal at the top. Takes about an hour.
before: Horde: Deathstalkers in Shadowfang, Arugal Must Die (Sepulcher). Alliance: The Book of Ur, Arugal Must Die (Duskwood/Silverpine). Free the prisoners after Rethilgore to open the courtyard door.
route: Rethilgore in the cells, then talk to the prisoners
Razorclaw the Butcher in the kitchen
Baron Silverlaine in the dining hall
Odo the Blindwatcher on the bridge
Fenrus the Devourer, then Wolf Master Nandos
tips: Shadowfang worgen curse and fear. Watch for the bat cave and patrols on the stairs. Arugal teleports around the room.

bosses.summary: The first boss in the dungeon. Kill him to free the prisoners.
Butcher worgen in the kitchen.
Ghost who curses people.
bosses.healer: Dispel Veil of Shadow if you can.

bosses.summary: Paladin-type undead who heals himself.
Big worgen on the bridge who howls to buff himself.
Large wolf that puts a poison on people.
Worgen who calls wolves to help.
Mage who teleports around and turns people into worgen.
bosses.tank: Stay with him when he moves.
bosses.dps: Don't chase him too far; he teleports back.

bosses.summary: Rare spawn captain who appears in the courtyard.
Only appears during special world events.
Voidwalker trash that patrols.

name: Blackfathom Deeps
where: Ashenvale, Zoram Strand on the west coast. Underwater entrance in the ruined temple.
overview: A flooded Naga and Twilight cult temple with lots of swimming. Takes 1–1.5 hours.
before: Pick up Knowledge in the Deeps (Ironforge), Researching the Corruption and Blackfathom Villainy (Ashenvale / Auberdine).
route: Ghamoo-ra the turtle near the start
Lady Sarevess in the water room
Lorgus Jett patrols with his guards
Old Serra'kis in the underwater pool
Twilight Lord Kelris at the top
tips: Watch your breath bar when swimming. The Aku'mai fire event spawns waves of adds.

bosses.summary: Giant turtle. Simple.
Naga with a bow. Slows people.
Murloc boss in his cave.
Shark fight underwater.
bosses.tank: Keep it still so people can breathe at the surface.

bosses.summary: Puts people to sleep.
Final hydra. Frenzies and does poison clouds.
bosses.tank: Face it away from the group.

name: The Stockade
where: Inside Stormwind, next to the Mage Quarter canal. Alliance only.
overview: Stormwind's prison after a riot. A short dungeon of humans, best done for quests. About 30 minutes.
before: Lots of quests in Stormwind and Lakeshire: What Comes Around…, The Fury Runs Deep, Crime and Punishment, Quell the Uprising, The Color of Blood.
route: Hamhock, Bazil Thredd and Dextren Ward
Bruegal Ironknuckle is a rare spawn
tips: Prisoners flee when low and pull more. Kill fleeing mobs.

bosses.summary: Dwarf prisoner. Simple fight.
Rare spawn. Not always there.

name: Gnomeregan
where: Dun Morogh, through the gnome tunnels (or teleport from the back entrance with an engineer).
overview: The irradiated gnome capital full of leper gnomes and machines. Long and confusing. Takes 1.5–2 hours.
before: Lots of Ironforge/Gnome quests: Save Techbot!, Gyrodrillmatic Excavationators, Data Rescue (needs card keys).
tips: Radiation debuffs stack: kill quickly. Leper gnomes chain-pull a lot. Bombs on the floor: avoid them.

bosses.summary: Ooze that throws toxic damage around.
Robot with chain lightning.
Machine that stomps and knocks back.
bosses.tank: Keep it away from the walls.

bosses.summary: Rare spawn. Not always there.
Final boss. Bombs come out of the walls.

name: Razorfen Kraul
where: Southern Barrens, near the border with Thousand Needles.
overview: A maze of thorny vines with quilboar and boar beasts. About an hour.
before: Grab Blueleaf Tubers, Mortality Wanes, Willix the Importer (escort) and the RFK quest chain.
route: Roogug and Aggem near the start
tips: Quilboar shaman put down totems: kill them. Boars charge and knock back.

bosses.summary: Quilboar champion.
Mind controls players.
bosses.dps: Kill fast to stop mind control.

bosses.summary: Quilboar leader with a pack of helpers.
Rare spawn. Not always there.
Rare spawn bat.
Big quilboar boss.
Boar that charges around.
Final boss. Heals herself.

name: Scarlet Monastery
where: Tirisfal Glades, the monastery north-east of Brill. Four wings: Graveyard, Library, Armory and Cathedral.
overview: Four separate dungeons in one building, run as a levelling path: Graveyard (~30), Library (~33), Armory (~36), Cathedral (~38). Each wing is short (20–40 minutes).
before: Horde: Into The Scarlet Monastery, Hearts of Zeal, Compendium of the Fallen. Alliance: In the Name of the Light. The Library drops the key (Scarlet Key) that opens Armory and Cathedral.
route: Graveyard: Interrogator Vishas, Bloodmage Thalnos (and rare Ironspine / Azshir / Fallen Champion)
Cathedral: High Inquisitor Fairbanks (hidden behind the altar), then Mograine and Whitemane
tips: Scarlet mobs come in groups with healers: kill or interrupt the healers first. Doan's Arcane Explosion hurts: spread out.

bosses.summary: Graveyard boss in the torture room. Easy.
Graveyard rare spawn, not always there.
Graveyard rare spawn ghost.
Graveyard rare spawn.
End of Graveyard. Fire caster.
Library. Comes with dogs.
End of Library. Does big Arcane Explosions and a Detonation.
bosses.tank: When he shields himself, everyone run away from him.
bosses.dps: Spread out; run when he shouts.

bosses.summary: End of Armory. Whirlwinds and hits very hard. Spawns a wave of adds when he dies.
bosses.dps: Melee: get out during Whirlwind. Then deal with the adds.

bosses.summary: Hidden boss in the Cathedral's back room. Easy.
Cathedral. Paladin with stuns and a bubble. When he dies, Whitemane runs in.
bosses.tank: Be ready to pick up Whitemane straight away.
bosses.healer: Watch for his Hammer of Justice stun.
bosses.dps: Kill Mograine, then switch to Whitemane.

bosses.summary: Runs in after Mograine dies. Puts everyone to sleep and resurrects Mograine.
bosses.tank: Pick her up, then Mograine again when he stands up.
bosses.healer: Expect the group-wide sleep; heal everyone up afterwards.

bosses.summary: Only appears during special world events.

name: Razorfen Downs
where: Southern Barrens near Thousand Needles, close to Razorfen Kraul.
overview: Quilboar and undead in a grave site. Has a gong event. Takes about an hour.
before: Grab Bring the End and the Downs quest chain from the entrance and Thunder Bluff / Undercity.
route: Amnennar the Coldbringer at the end
tips: Undead debuffs stack. The gong event spawns waves: hold together.

bosses.summary: Spider spawned by the gong event. Stuns and poisons.
Rare-ish quilboar.
Fire caster.
Big undead. Enrages.
Rare spawn.
Only appears during special world events.
Final boss. Frost caster with frost novas.

name: Uldaman
where: Badlands, the excavation site in the north. The back entrance is faster.
overview: A titan vault full of troggs and stone keepers. Long dungeon, about 1.5 hours.
before: Grab the platinum disc quests and The Lost Dwarves. Bring a way to deal with lots of stone golems.
route: The Lost Dwarves: Baelog, Eric "The Swift", Olaf
tips: The stone keepers come in from the walls: deal with them as they spawn.

bosses.summary: Trogg caster.
One of the Lost Dwarves.
One of the Lost Dwarves.
One of the Lost Dwarves.
Giant stone giant who stomps.
Stone keeper who fights in place.
Dark Iron dwarf.
Trogg chief.
Final boss. Wakes up stone keepers during the fight.

name: Zul'Farrak
where: Tanaris, north-west. The troll city in the desert.
overview: A big outdoor troll city with the famous stairs event. About 1.5 hours.
before: Grab Divino-matic Rod, Tiara of the Deep, Gahz'rilla and the Scarab quests. Free the prisoners at the top of the stairs.
route: Witch Doctor Zum'rah in the graveyard
The stairs event with Sergeant Bly
Chief Ukorz Sandscalp at the top
tips: The stairs event spawns big waves: hold the top of the stairs. Avoid the scarabs.

bosses.summary: Troll in the basilisk pit. Summons basilisks.
Raises undead from graves.
Hydra summoned with a hammer. Freezes people.
Part of the stairs event.
Priest who heals.
Final boss.
Rare spawn.
Rare spawn.

name: Maraudon
where: Desolace, south-west. Orange and purple entrances in the cave.
overview: A huge cave with centaurs and elementals. Several wings. 2+ hours for a full clear.
before: Grab Legends of Maraudon, Corruption of Earth and Seed and the scepter quests.
route: Noxxion and Razorlash in the purple wing
Lord Vyletongue and Celebras in the orange wing
tips: Lots of poison and slows. Stay together in the big open areas.

bosses.summary: Centaur leader. A straightforward fight.
Rare spawn.
Poison elemental. Splits into adds.
Plant monster.
Tree lord. Fights then gives a quest after.
Goblin with bombs.
Big crocolisk in the water.
Rock elemental that knocks back.
Final boss. Knocks back and summons adds.

name: Sunken Temple
where: Swamp of Sorrows, the temple in the lake (The Temple of Atal'Hakkar).
overview: A troll temple partly under water, with a statue puzzle and dragon bosses. About 1.5–2 hours.
before: Grab the quests from the Stranglethorn/Swamp of Sorrows chain and The Temple of Atal'Hakkar.
route: Do the statue circle puzzle to summon Atal'alarion
Jammal'an the Prophet and Ogom the Wretched
Shade of Eranikus at the end
tips: Lots of dragonkin fear and sleep. Pull carefully.

bosses.summary: Summoned by the statue puzzle. Hits hard.
Rare spawn.
Troll boss near Jammal'an.
Troll caster. Mind controls.
Final boss dragon. Puts people to sleep.

name: Blackrock Depths
where: Blackrock Mountain, between Searing Gorge and Burning Steppes. Go down the chains inside the mountain.
overview: A huge Dark Iron dwarf city. Too big to clear in one go: groups usually do it in sections (prison, Ring of Law, the bar, then the Emperor). A full run can take 3+ hours.
before: Some doors need keys you earn through quests. The Shadowforge Key opens the way into the city, so ask who in the group has it. There are lots of quests for both factions in Thorium Point, Kargath and Morgan's Vigil.
route: Ring of Law: an arena fight (random boss) then Theldren or the Gladiator event
Lord Roccor and Houndmaster Grebmar near the start
Shadowforge Lock to open the city
Bael'Gar, General Angerforge and Golem Lord Argelmach
Grim Guzzler bar: Plugger Spazzring, Hurley Blackbreath, Phalanx
Lord Incendius at the Black Anvil
Magmus at the gate, then Emperor Dagran Thaurissan and Princess Moira
tips: Don't make the bar angry unless you mean to: if anyone attacks a patron, the whole bar turns on you. Pull carefully in the city, patrols are frequent.

bosses.summary: Priest in the prison. Uses Shadow Word: Pain and a Psychic Scream fear.
bosses.tank: Tank her near a wall so feared people don't run into packs.

bosses.summary: Fire elemental in the corridor. Easy.
Dwarf with dogs. Kill the dogs.
One of the random Ring of Law arena bosses.
One of the random Ring of Law arena bosses.
One of the random Ring of Law arena bosses. Whirlwinds.
One of the random Ring of Law arena bosses. Stomps.
One of the random Ring of Law arena bosses. Spider that paralyses.
One of the random Ring of Law arena bosses. Arcane caster.
Fire caster who drops fire totems.
Frost caster in the vault area.
Hound that joins near Stilgiss. A normal fight.
Dwarf architect near the Hall of Crafting. Simple.
Giant fire elemental. Summons small fire adds.
Fire elemental at the Black Anvil. Hits hard with fire.
bosses.healer: Heavy fire damage on the tank.

bosses.summary: Calls lots of adds at around 30% health.
bosses.tank: Pick up the adds, keep the general on you.
bosses.healer: Big healing needed when the adds arrive.
bosses.dps: Save cooldowns for the end; burn him at 30%.

bosses.summary: Golem lord. Wakes up golems around him if you're not careful.
Fire elemental who calls small fire adds from the runes.
bosses.dps: Kill the adds before they reach him.

bosses.summary: Giant at the gate to the Emperor. Fire jets in the room: stand clear.
bosses.tank: Tank him away from the fire jets.

bosses.summary: Rare spawn or optional mob, not always there. A normal fight.
Bartender in the Grim Guzzler. Only fights if the bar turns on you.
Spawns when you steal the Dark Iron Ale. Comes with friends.
Golem guard in the bar. Fights after Hurley/Plugger events.
One of the Seven Dwarves. They come one after another: kill each before the next.
bosses.dps: Kill each dwarf before the next joins.

bosses.summary: Leader of the Seven Dwarves. Talk to him to start the fight.
Heals the Emperor. Some quests need her left alive, so check before killing her.
bosses.dps: Interrupt her heals on the Emperor.

bosses.summary: Final boss. Hits the tank hard and puts fire on people.
bosses.tank: Tank him facing away from the group.
bosses.dps: Interrupt Moira's heals so the Emperor goes down.

bosses.summary: Rare spawn or optional mob, not always there. A normal fight.

name: Lower Blackrock Spire
where: Blackrock Mountain, upper part (go up the mountain, not down to BRD).
overview: Orcs, ogres and spiders in Blackrock Spire. 5-player dungeon. Takes 1.5–2 hours.
before: Grab the Seal of Ascension quest (to get the UBRS key) and Mother Smolderweb's quest. Horde get extra quests from Thrall's line.
route: Highlord Omokk on the upper path
Mother Smolderweb in the spider area
tips: Spider eggs hatch if you walk on them. Lots of orc patrols: pull carefully.

bosses.summary: Big ogre. Knocks the tank back.
bosses.tank: Stand with your back to a wall.

bosses.summary: Troll caster. Hexes and puts curses on people.
Orc who throws axes and snaps kicks.
Giant spider in the nest. Poisons and webs people.
Event boss summoned with a spear at the pedestal. Comes with adds.
Orc who drinks a healing potion.
Big worg. Simple.
Big worg that spawns after Halycon dies.
Final boss. Calls two adds at about 50%.
Rare spawn or optional mob, not always there. A normal fight.
Rare spawn or optional mob, not always there. A normal fight.
Rare spawn or optional mob, not always there. A normal fight.
Rare spawn or optional mob, not always there. A normal fight.
Rare spawn or optional mob, not always there. A normal fight.
Rare spawn or optional mob, not always there. A normal fight.
Rare spawn or optional mob, not always there. A normal fight.
Summoned with a special item. Optional.

name: Upper Blackrock Spire
where: Blackrock Mountain, Blackrock Spire. Through the door that needs the Seal of Ascension.
overview: A 10-player raid dungeon at the top of Blackrock Spire. Dragonkin and Rend Blackhand. Part of the Onyxia attunement for Alliance. Takes 2–2.5 hours.
before: Someone must have the Seal of Ascension (from LBRS). Alliance: get the Onyxia attunement quests from Windsor's chain. Horde: the Drakkisath chain.
route: Pyroguard Emberseer (break the runes to wake him)
Solakar Flamewreath in the egg room
Warchief Rend Blackhand and Gyth in the arena
tips: Lots of dragonkin: tank them facing away. The Rend event has big waves before Rend himself comes.

bosses.summary: Fire elemental. The group clicks the runes around the room to wake him.
Event boss in the egg room. Breaking an egg starts waves of whelps.
Rare spawn or optional mob, not always there. A normal fight.
Blacksmith ogre. Simple.
Dragon Rend rides at the start of his fight. Breathes and casts poison.
bosses.tank: Face Gyth away from the group.

bosses.summary: Arena event: waves of orcs and dragons first, then Rend on Gyth, then Rend on foot.
bosses.tank: Hold the waves; then grab Rend when he dismounts.
bosses.dps: Focus the waves, then Gyth, then Rend.

bosses.summary: Huge beast that fires a fireball and knocks people away.
Final boss with two guards. Conflagration makes people run around.
bosses.tank: Two tanks: one for Drakkisath, one for the guards.

bosses.summary: Summoned with a special item. Optional.

name: Dire Maul
where: Feralas, the ruined city in the east. Three wings: East, West and North.
overview: A ruined elven city with three short wings. North is the famous "tribute run" where you leave the ogres alive for a chest. Each wing takes 30–60 minutes.
before: Get the Crescent Key from the East wing (Pusillin) to open North and West. Grab the Dire Maul quests in Feralas and the libram quests.
route: East: chase Pusillin for the key, then Zevrim Thornhoof, Hydrospawn, Lethtendris, Alzzin the Wildshaper
West: kill the pylon guards to drop Immol'thar's shield, then Tendris Warpwood, Magister Kalendris, Illyanna Ravenoak, Immol'thar, Prince Tortheldrin
North: Guard Mol'dar, Stomper Kreeg, Guard Fengus, Guard Slip'kik, Captain Kromcrush, King Gordok (or the tribute run)
tips: Tribute run (North): sneak past the guards without killing them and only kill King Gordok. The ogres then give you a big chest. Bring a rogue or mage for the trick.

bosses.summary: Satyr in the East wing. Sacrifices a player.
Water elemental. Knocks back and splashes.
Satyr caster with a pet.
End of East. Shapeshifts and summons wildspawn.
Lethtendris's pet imp. Dies with her fight.
Big tree. Entangles and knocks people up.
Shadow priest. Mind blasts and mind controls.
Hunter with a pet bear.
Huge demon. Shield goes down when the 5 pylon guards are dead. Spawns small eyes.
bosses.tank: Swap tanks if needed; he has a threat drop.

bosses.summary: End of West. Whirlwinds and counterspells.
Warlock quest demon. Optional.
Event boss. Optional.
Summoned with a special item. Optional.
Rare spawn or optional mob, not always there. A normal fight.
Drunk ogre in North. Don't kill him on a tribute run.
Gordok's caster. Fights alongside the King.
Ogre captain who calls for help. Kill him for a full clear.
Goblin who gives you the tribute chest after King Gordok dies.
Ogre king. Hits hard and shouts.

name: Scholomance
where: Western Plaguelands, the island in Caer Darrow.
overview: A school of necromancy full of undead. Long but rewarding, with dungeon set gear. About 2 hours.
before: You need the Skeleton Key (quest chain from the Western Plaguelands) to get in. Grab the Barov family quests and the Doctor Theolen Krastinov quest.
route: Kirtonos the Herald (light the brazier with Blood of Innocents)
Doctor Theolen Krastinov and the other class rooms
tips: Lots of curses and fears. Bring curse removal. Gandling teleports people into side rooms full of adds.

bosses.summary: Bird demon that shapeshifts. Summoned at the balcony.
Makes lots of illusions of herself.
bosses.dps: AoE the illusions, or find the real one.

bosses.summary: Big bone construct. Simple but hits hard.
Lich. Frost bolts and freezes people.
Summoned with a special item. Optional.
Event boss. Optional.
Summoned with a special item. Optional.
Final boss. Teleports people into side rooms with adds.
bosses.dps: If teleported, kill the adds and come back.

name: Stratholme
where: Eastern Plaguelands, north. Main gate (Live side) or Service Entrance (Undead side).
overview: The burning city. Live side is Scarlet Crusade; Undead side is the Scourge leading to Baron Rivendare. Each side takes 1–1.5 hours.
before: Undead side: get the Key to the City or come in the service entrance. Grab the Postmaster and Ramstein quests. The Baron run has a 45-minute timer for a bonus.
route: Live side: Malor, Cannon Master Willey, Archivist Galford, Grand Crusader Dathrohan (Balnazzar)
Undead side: Baroness Anastari, Nerub'enkan, Maleki the Pallid, Magistrate Barthilas, Ramstein the Gorger, Baron Rivendare
tips: Lots of disease and fear. On the Baron run, kill the 3 ziggurat bosses to open his door.

bosses.summary: Rare spawn or optional mob, not always there. A normal fight.
Rare spawn or optional mob, not always there. A normal fight.
Spawns when you clear his courtyard. Strong but simple.
Rare spawn or optional mob, not always there. A normal fight.
Spawns after you open the mailboxes with keys. Optional.
Ghost that freezes people.
Calls riflemen who shoot the group.
Fire caster in the library.
End of Live side. Turns into Balnazzar at half health.
bosses.healer: Big healing when he changes form.

bosses.summary: Banshee who mind controls people.
Spider with poison and adds.
Frost caster.
Simple fight in the Undead side.
Big abomination that knocks people away.
Final boss. Hits the tank hard and raises skeleton adds.
bosses.tank: Keep him on you; expect heavy hits.

bosses.summary: Event boss. Optional.

name: Molten Core
where: Blackrock Mountain. Enter through Blackrock Depths (at the Lothos Riftwaker attunement), or swim in from the BRD entrance.
overview: The first 40-player raid. Fire elementals and core hounds, ending with Ragnaros. A first clear can take a whole evening (3–4 hours).
before: Everyone needs to be attuned (Attunement to the Core: grab a Core Fragment near Lothos in BRD). For Ragnaros, raid members need fire resistance gear, and someone needs Aqual Quintessence to douse the runes. Bring plenty of fire protection potions.
route: Douse the 7 runes (Aqual Quintessence) to summon Majordomo Executus
tips: Lava burns: stay on the path. Core hounds come in packs of 5 and must die within 10 seconds of each other or they revive. Decurse and dispel constantly.

bosses.summary: Two Flamewaker Protectors with him mind control people. He curses the raid with Lucifron's Curse.
bosses.tank: Three tanks: one on Lucifron, one each on the adds.
bosses.healer: Remove curses and Impending Doom. Dispel mind control.
bosses.dps: Kill the two adds first, then Lucifron.

bosses.summary: Big core hound. Fears the raid, enrages, and puts lava pools on the ground.
bosses.tank: Fear Ward or Tremor Totem on the tank. Tank him away from the raid.
bosses.healer: Use Fear Ward on the tank; heal through the frenzy.
bosses.dps: Hunters: Tranquilizing Shot when he frenzies. Everyone move out of the fire.

bosses.summary: Flamewaker with two adds. Curses the raid so healing is weaker. Rains fire.
bosses.tank: Three tanks: Gehennas and two adds.
bosses.healer: Remove Gehennas' Curse as fast as you can.
bosses.dps: Kill the adds first; move out of Rain of Fire.

bosses.summary: Big rock elemental with 8 Firesworn adds that explode when killed.
bosses.tank: Lots of tanks: Garr plus the adds, or warlocks banish some adds.
bosses.dps: Kill adds one at a time away from the raid. Don't stand near an add when it dies.

bosses.summary: Teleports to random people, does Arcane Explosion, curses and counterspells.
Picks a "Living Bomb" player who explodes after a few seconds. Inferno pulse. Mana-drains casters.
bosses.healer: Watch for the Living Bomb player and heal them before they explode.
bosses.dps: If you're the Living Bomb, RUN out of the raid. Spread out.

bosses.summary: Big giant with two Core Rager dogs. Magma Splash stacks up on his tank, and he Pyroblasts random people.
bosses.tank: One tank on Golemagg (swap if stacks get high), one on each Core Rager, tanked away from him.
bosses.healer: Heavy tank healing as Magma Splash stacks.
bosses.dps: Only kill Golemagg. The Core Ragers can't be killed while he lives.

bosses.summary: Flamewaker with 4 priest adds that heal each other.
bosses.tank: Several tanks: Sulfuron plus the 4 priests.
bosses.dps: Kill the 4 priests first, interrupting their heals.

bosses.summary: Comes with 8 adds (4 healers, 4 elites). You win by killing the adds; Majordomo surrenders. He reflects damage and teleports people.
bosses.tank: Lots of tanks. Watch for Magic Reflection and Damage Shield.
bosses.healer: Lots of healing on the add tanks.
bosses.dps: Kill healer adds first. Stop casting when Magic Reflection is up; stop melee when Damage Shield is up.

bosses.summary: Final boss. Wrath of Ragnaros knocks melee back; Lava Burst hits ranged. After a while he submerges and Sons of Flame come out.
bosses.tank: Two tanks: one gets knocked back by Wrath, the other picks him up.
bosses.healer: Fire resistance gear for tanks. Heal through the knockback.
bosses.dps: Kill the 8 Sons of Flame when he submerges. Melee: watch Wrath of Ragnaros.

name: Onyxia's Lair
where: Dustwallow Marsh, the cave in the far south (Wyrmbog).
overview: A 40-player raid with one boss: the black dragon Onyxia. About 30–60 minutes once you know the fight.
before: Everyone needs the Drakefire Amulet (Onyxia attunement chain, Alliance from Windsor's line, Horde from Rexxar's line). Fire resistance helps the tanks.
route: Clear the whelp eggs carefully at the back of the cave
tips: Never stand in front of her (fire breath) or behind her (tail swipe). Stay away from the whelp cave walls when she's airborne.

bosses.summary: Three phases. 1: on the ground; stand at her sides. 2 (65%): she flies, breathes Deep Breath across the room and whelps pour in. 3 (40%): she lands, fears the room, and lava erupts from the floor.
bosses.tank: Tank her with her head facing the wall, never towards the raid.
bosses.healer: Fear Ward/Tremor Totem the tank in phase 3. Heal through the eruptions.
bosses.dps: Phase 2: kill the whelps and move out of her Deep Breath line. Phase 3: avoid the cracks in the floor (lava eruptions), and be ready to get feared.

name: Blackwing Lair
where: Blackrock Mountain, at the very top of Upper Blackrock Spire (attunement by touching the orb behind Drakkisath).
overview: A 40-player raid for Nefarian and his dragons. Harder than Molten Core. A full clear takes a whole evening.
before: Everyone must be attuned (Blackhand's Command, from the orb behind General Drakkisath). Bring Onyxia Scale Cloaks for the Nefarian fight.
tips: Lots of suppression traps between bosses: rogues can disarm them. Technician packs hit hard.

bosses.summary: Mind-control Razorgore with the orb to destroy the 30 eggs while the raid holds off waves of adds. Then he fights.
bosses.tank: Hold the adds at the doors.
bosses.healer: Lots of add damage on tanks.
bosses.dps: Kill adds; the mind controller destroys the eggs.

bosses.summary: Starts almost dead but you get a huge mana and energy buff. Burning Adrenaline makes a player explode after 20 seconds.
bosses.tank: Several tanks in a line: if a tank gets Burning Adrenaline, the next takes over.
bosses.dps: If you get Burning Adrenaline, run away from the raid. Huge DPS race.

bosses.summary: Hits the tank hard and knocks him away.
bosses.tank: Two tanks to swap aggro after knockbacks.
bosses.dps: Don't pull extra threat after knockbacks.

bosses.summary: Dragon that puts a stacking Flame Buffet on everyone in line of sight.
bosses.tank: Swap tanks when stacks get high.
bosses.dps: Hide behind pillars to drop your stacks.

bosses.summary: Dragon whose Shadow of Ebonroc heals him when he hits that tank.
bosses.tank: Swap tanks when one gets Shadow of Ebonroc.

bosses.summary: Dragon that frenzies.
bosses.tank: Face him away from the raid.
bosses.dps: Hunters: Tranquilizing Shot when he frenzies.

bosses.summary: Dragon with two random breaths each week and a stacking set of debuffs (Brood Afflictions).
bosses.tank: Tank him so the raid can hide from the breaths behind the doors.
bosses.healer: Hourglass Sand cures Bronze affliction. Dispel the others.
bosses.dps: Hide behind the doors when he breathes.

bosses.summary: Phase 1: Lord Victor Nefarius calls drakonid adds. Phase 2: Nefarian lands; class calls hit each class. Phase 3 (20%): skeletons rise.
bosses.tank: Tank him facing away from the raid (shadowflame).
bosses.healer: Onyxia Scale Cloaks protect everyone from Shadowflame.
bosses.dps: Learn your class call. Kill the adds in phase 1 and skeletons in phase 3.

bosses.summary: Trash before Chromaggus. Has a random vulnerability.
bosses.dps: Find its weak school and use it.

name: Zul'Gurub
where: Northern Stranglethorn Vale, the troll city in the east.
overview: A 20-player raid of troll high priests and Hakkar the Soulflayer. About 2–3 hours.
before: No attunement. Kill the 4 required high priests to weaken Hakkar. Bring someone who can fish (for Gahz'ranka).
route: Edge of Madness (one of 4 bosses at random)
tips: Each high priest you kill makes Hakkar weaker. Poison and curse removal are very useful.

bosses.summary: Bat priestess. Silences, fears, then throws fire bombs from the air.
bosses.dps: Interrupt the heal; kill bat adds.

bosses.summary: Snake priest. Holy Wrath and Poison Clouds. Becomes a snake at 50%.
Spider priestess. Spawns spiders and poisons.
Tiger priest with two helpers. All three must die close together.
Panther priestess. Goes stealth and marks a player for panthers.
Rides a raptor. Watches a player and charges them if they act.
bosses.tank: Tank both him and the raptor.
bosses.dps: If he says he's watching you, stop everything.

bosses.summary: Edge of Madness boss (random each week).
Edge of Madness boss (random each week). Makes nightmare illusions.
Edge of Madness boss (random each week). Vanishes and reappears.
Edge of Madness boss (random each week). Chain lightning.
Fish him up with a Mudskunk Lure. Knocks people up.
Hexes people, summons shades, and puts brain wash totems down.
Final boss. Blood Siphon drains the raid and heals him, unless people have Poisonous Blood. Also mind controls. Killing the 4 high priests beforehand removes some of his abilities.
bosses.healer: Heavy raid healing around Blood Siphon.
bosses.dps: Before each Blood Siphon, get the Poisonous Blood debuff by killing Sons of Hakkar near you.

name: Ruins of Ahn'Qiraj
where: Silithus, the southern gate (opened by the Ahn'Qiraj war effort).
overview: A 20-player raid of insects and qiraji. Shorter than Zul'Gurub, about 1.5–2 hours.
before: No attunement. Nature resistance helps for some fights.
tips: Lots of silithid trash: AoE them down.

bosses.summary: Mortal Wound stacks on the tank. Sand traps appear.
bosses.tank: Swap tanks when stacks get high.

bosses.summary: Waves of qiraji, then Rajaxx himself.
Drains mana from casters, then turns to stone and spawns elementals.
Chases a player. Kill his eggs next to him to hurt him.
bosses.dps: Break eggs when Buru is next to them.

bosses.summary: Flying wasp. Lands at 70%.
bosses.dps: Ranged DPS do the early work.

bosses.summary: Must be dragged to crystals to change his weakness.

name: Temple of Ahn'Qiraj
where: Silithus, the northern gate (opened by the Ahn'Qiraj war effort).
overview: A 40-player raid ending with C'Thun. One of the hardest raids. Takes several evenings to clear.
before: No attunement. Nature resistance for Huhuran and Viscidus; frost damage for Viscidus.
route: The Bug Trio (Vem, Lord Kri, Princess Yauj)
tips: Anubisath guards have random abilities. Mind control and silence everywhere.

bosses.summary: Splits into copies at 75%/50%/25% and mind controls.
Part of the Bug Trio. Kill order matters.
Part of the Bug Trio. Leaves a poison cloud when he dies.
Part of the Bug Trio. Heals and fears.
Whirlwinds with guard adds.
Spawns worms. Mortal Wound on tanks.
Freeze him with frost damage, then shatter with melee.
bosses.dps: Use frost spells/wands to freeze him.

bosses.summary: Poisons and goes berserk at 30%.
Twin Emperor (caster). Swaps places with his brother.
Twin Emperor (melee). Swaps places with his brother.
Giant sandworm. Submerges and resurfaces under people.
Final boss. Eye beams and tentacles; then you go inside his stomach.
Not a regular boss in the temple. You can ignore this entry.

name: Naxxramas
where: Floating necropolis over Eastern Plaguelands (entrance at Light's Hope Chapel).
overview: The hardest Classic raid. Four wings (Arachnid, Plague, Military, Construct), then Frostwyrm Lair. Weeks of progress for most guilds.
before: Attunement from the Argent Dawn at Light's Hope. Frost resistance for Sapphiron.
route: Arachnid Quarter: Anub'Rekhan, Grand Widow Faerlina, Maexxna
Plague Quarter: Noth the Plaguebringer, Heigan the Unclean, Loatheb
Military Quarter: Instructor Razuvious, Gothik the Harvester, The Four Horsemen
Construct Quarter: Patchwerk, Grobbulus, Gluth, Thaddius
tips: Each wing ends with a teleporter back to the entrance. Consumables are essential.

bosses.summary: Locust Swarm: kite him around the room.
Enrages. Priests mind control her worshippers to stop it.
Webs players to the wall and spawns spiderlings.
Teleports to the balcony and spawns skeletons.
The "safety dance": the floor erupts in moving waves.
Healing only possible every few seconds; spores give crit.
Priests mind control his students to tank him.
Waves of adds on both sides of the room.
Four horsemen, each with stacking marks. Tanks rotate between them.
Tank-and-spank DPS race. Hateful Strike hits high-health tanks.
Injects players who leave poison clouds.
Eats zombies to heal; frenzies.
Polarity shift: positive and negative charges.
Frost dragon. Ice blocks players.
bosses.dps: Hide behind ice blocks during Frost Breath.

bosses.summary: Final boss. Waves of adds, then Kel'Thuzad.
